## Independent Method Review — Yeast Reporter Microscopy (ND2 + AVI)

**Evidence ceiling.** With incomplete protocol/sample mapping, the defensible deliverable is a provenance-annotated inventory + QC report + descriptive per-field/per-culture traces. Group comparisons and kinetics are conditional on recovered metadata, never on assumption. Fluorescence brightness is not a Cd-binding measurement; without calibration standards (known Cd, same strain/optics/exposure), no calibrated concentration or binding claim is supportable.

**Metadata recovery.** Read ND2 with two independent readers (Bio-Formats and the Python `nd2` package) and cross-check — Bio-Formats has documented bugs splitting timepoints into series or misassigning T/Z in ND2 timelapse+Z files [23]. Extract SizeX/Y/Z/C/T, `SignificantBits` vs storage type (verify 12-bit data maxes at 4095 in a uint16 container), `PhysicalSizeX/Y/Z`, channel names, per-plane exposure, `DeltaT`, and stage positions — all are supported ND2 fields [16, 17, 18]. Frame index is not time; only `DeltaT` is the time axis. A "Z" dimension is a z-stack only if ZStackLoop/step metadata exists [18, 24]. Treat every AVI as derived/secondary (8-bit, compressed, LUT-applied): visual QC only, never quantification. Detect AVI↔ND2 duplicates by timestamps, frame count, and first-frame correlation; record match status in the manifest.

**Units of inference.** The independent unit is the **culture**. Fields within a culture, cells within a field, and frames within a track are nested observations; treating them as N is pseudoreplication and inflates false positives [26, 27, 28, 29]. One culture per condition = descriptive analysis only.

**Metrics (native depth, raw ADU).** Whole-field: background-subtracted median intensity, saturated-pixel fraction, focus score (Laplacian variance on transmitted light), drift via phase correlation. Cell-level: per-cell **median** background-subtracted intensity, integrated intensity above background, area/shape from the transmitted-light mask. Avoid cross-channel ratios when exposure/gain differ; never rescale or gamma-correct before measuring.

**Segmentation.** Segment on transmitted light, not the reporter channel — fluorescence-based masks select for high expressers and couple mask to measurement. Threshold+watershed for clean yeast; DeLTA [4], BABY [6], or Partaker [2] if deep learning is warranted. Mandatory overlay QC: masks rendered on both channels for a random sample spanning the recording, ≥5% of frames manually reviewed, exclusion rules (clumps, buds, edge cells) fixed in code before looking at fluorescence outcomes. Report track fragmentation; if tracks fragment, aggregate at field level.

**Background subtraction.** Per-frame, per-channel estimates from cell-free regions (low-percentile median or rolling-ball); never a global constant across a drifting recording. Flat-field only if reference flats exist. Watch over-subtraction at cell halos [9, 13, 15]; report background level over time as its own QC trace.

**Diagnostics gating every field:** saturation (any saturated pixels in cell ROIs → flag/exclude), bleaching (fit exponential decay of whole-field signal; correct only with documented fit, else restrict to within-frame comparisons), focus (exclude frames below ~50% of field median), drift (register if rigid and <~0.5 px, else exclude), and exposure/gain changes (split into homogeneous segments; never pool).

**Kinetics — three hard preconditions.** Onset/t50/t90 only if (1) monotonic `DeltaT` timestamps are recovered, (2) the Cd-addition time is **documented** in notes or metadata — if missing, it must not be invented as observed, and (3) a plateau is demonstrable (last-20% slope below threshold). Compute t50/t90 by interpolation on per-field traces; onset as baseline + k·MAD with censoring noted. If event time is unknown, assumed-time alignment may appear **only** in clearly labeled sensitivity analyses alongside the unanchored version.

**Statistics.** Aggregate cells → field → culture; compare cultures, or use mixed models with culture/field as random effects [28, 29]. No p-values with cell- or frame-level n. Every exclusion rule pre-registered in code with reported counts.

**Stop short of causal Cd conclusions when:** the addition event is unrecoverable; no same-session unexposed control at identical settings; exposure/gain differ across conditions without calibration; no Cd standards exist; a condition survives only as AVI; or bleaching/saturation/focus are uncorrectable in many fields. Then the deliverable is inventory + QC + caveated descriptive traces, plus a list of what metadata or controls would unlock stronger inference.

Full version with the complete checklist, diagnostic table, and all primary sources (Bio-Formats/Nikon documentation, Jonkman 2020, Senft 2023, Lazic 2018, Eisner 2021, Zimmerman 2021, and single-cell yeast quantification methods) is in the saved report.
